_dailyRegularLimit_note: Daily Regular = MIN(Paid Hours, dailyRegularLimit); Daily OT = MAX(Paid Hours - dailyRegularLimit, 0).
_dailyOvertimeLimit_note: Used ONLY to auto-fill a day that is entirely missing from an otherwise-present employee's row in the uploaded weekly payroll sheet (e.g. the sheet was exported before the week finished) -- never to override a day that IS present there. Mirrors the weekly payroll workbook's own confirmed daily formula: Regular = MIN(Paid Hours, dailyRegularLimit); Overtime = MIN(MAX(Paid Hours - dailyRegularLimit, 0), dailyOvertimeLimit); Double = MAX(Paid Hours - dailyRegularLimit - dailyOvertimeLimit, 0). If this is missing/null, a gap blocks generation instead of being auto-filled.
_overtimeMultiplier_note: OT Rate = Hourly Rate x overtimeMultiplier.
_maxWeeklyPeriodDays_note: If the uploaded timesheet's earliest-to-latest date span exceeds this many days, generation is blocked with 'Timesheet contains more than one weekly period.' so two weeks can never accidentally get processed as one.
_jobClassifications_note: Read straight from the timesheet's own Jobcode1 (per the SOP, entity/classification matching uses Jobcode1 only), never from an employee name list. Each key is a keyword to search for (case-insensitive substring match). wcRate and excludeFromClubhouse are INDEPENDENT settings on the same classification -- per the SOP, an employee whose job code contains 'Supervision' (e.g. Carlos Silva) gets ONLY the lower supervisor workers'-comp rate here; it does NOT remove them from Clubhouse billing. This is optional, useful functionality, but it is NOT part of the SOP's billing scope -- clubhouseExclusions below is the only thing that removes someone from the calculation.
_clubhouseExclusions_note: Per the SOP (explicitly, twice): exclude Hazel and Paul from Clubhouse because their hours are calculated separately. This is the ONLY thing that removes an employee from the Clubhouse calculation -- who's otherwise in scope is decided purely by the timesheet's own Jobcode1 data (anyone with any Clubhouse/BluntD/Crysp hours that week), never by a roster or by jobClassifications. This is a manual, name-based list, independent of job classification -- Paul Bates has no 'Supervision' job code at all, and Hazel Herrera does, yet both are excluded purely because they're on this list.

employerTax._note: defaultRatePercent is the standard employer tax rule to use for any employee without an explicit override below. The per-employee overrides currently on file (Carlos Silva, Genesis Lopez, Paola Sanchez, Sylvia Lopez) are the EXACT figures reproduced by the Sep 14-20 2026 reference payroll output -- they are NOT guaranteed to be correct for future weeks. Before running a new week, replace these with the actual employer tax rate/source for that payroll run (the confirmed standard rate, or that week's Gusto/payroll-provider figures), or the future dollar amounts may be off by cents or more. If a rate is not supplied for an employee, generation is blocked rather than guessing.

workersComp._note: General labor gets defaultRate. Anyone whose job codes match a jobClassifications keyword above gets that classification's wcRate instead (independent of whether they're excluded from Clubhouse billing). overrides is a manual escape hatch for any other exception.
